title: Approve once or create a narrow rule
steps: Open the approval dock. Inspect owner/session/child, generation, normalized tool arguments, cwd, target and effect boundary.
Choose Allow once or Deny. The reply addresses one exact waiter generation.
Await the exact reply acknowledgement; the card disables duplicate replies.
Optionally open a separate persistent-rule draft in S13. Test the match against a sample operation.
Apply future policy only after daemon acknowledgement; the rule gets a named scope, version and expiry.
forbidden_fake_states: a rule shown active without a policy store
duplicate reply generating a second effect
complete_when: one exact approval resolves once; a persisted rule has named scope, version and expiry (p.184).
traceability: p.184; controls Q-01..Q-09, Q-13, Q-14, X-12, B-12, D-12; acceptance A17, A18, A19.
